items: 🤖 Exam information is now AI-maintained: the exam-watch agent’s checked updates (key dates and new questions) go live automatically, and Key dates shows “Kept up to date by an AI agent — last checked …”.

kids: 🧭 A refreshed tour, and your Focus Zone now names your own exam
items: 🛡️ Deleting a player now needs their name typed exactly (plus the grown-up passphrase), and deleted players go to a ♻️ recycle bin for 30 days — restore them from “Who’s playing?” with all their progress.
🪐 Starlane now always opens from its own site (stuartokin.github.io/Starlane); the copy built into ApolloMaths has been removed, so the app is smaller and faster.
🚀 Maths questions sent to Starlane now use the child’s own name and theme (never “Apollo”).
⭐ The Focus Zone names each child’s own exam, and existing players on other exams get focus topics from their exam (unless a grown-up chose them).
👪 The family-codes reminder moved from the children’s screen to the Grown-ups button (⚠️). Setup adds “🙂 I’ll design my own” for the character.
🎓 The guided tour and Help are updated for the new layout — the tour now visits every area (16 steps).
🤖 Exam watch: it now proposes key dates from official sources (shown with ✨ once you merge) and drafts whole question generators, each run 50 times in a sandbox and checked by a second solve.
🧩 engine.html: the question engine on its own, so the Starlane site can offer exam practice.

kids: 🕹️ Every arcade game now lets you choose: 🧍 My player or 👾 Classic
items: 🕹️ Every arcade game except Starlane now has the 🧍 My player / 👾 Classic choice that Invaders had. My player puts your character and theme into the game; Classic is the original game with its original items. Each game remembers its own choice.

kids: 🕹️ You are the player in every arcade game now — in your own theme!
items: 👪 Parent dashboard: one fixed size whatever tab you pick (only the content scrolls, and each tab opens at the top); maximise fills the screen exactly; and fixed “undefined%” in the readiness tables — the cause was two functions with the same name. “No test date set yet” instead of “has passed” when there is no date.
💾 Not saved is now impossible to miss: a red, gently pulsing save button on laptops; on phones a red “Not saved — tap to save” ribbon across the top and a red 💾 button.

🕹️ Every arcade game except Starlane now uses the child’s own character as the player — in the maze, the snake, the racing car, the ships, the bat, the road crossing — or as a mascot in Pinball and Block Drop, ringed in the theme colour, with theme items to collect (⚽, 🐞, ⭐ or 🎵).
🧹 Removed the two-player option and the retro-screen (old-TV scanlines) switch from the arcade.
🖥️ Very large displays now scale only the children’s screen, so pop-up windows (the parent dashboard, the arcade) always fit.

kids: 💾 One save button that tells you whether you’re saved — and themed starter outfits
items: 💾 Saving has one clear home: a save button in the side rail (top right on phones) that shows “✅ Saved 15:13” or “⚠️ Not saved — tap to save”, and opens Save, Open, Save as and Export. Fixed: the save buttons had been hidden on the child’s screen when progress wasn’t saved yet.
🖥️ Large desktops use the whole width (four columns above 1,800 pixels), and very large displays scale everything up (120% from 2,400 pixels, 140% from 3,200) so it stays readable.
ℹ️ The footer shows just the essentials — name, Help, version and ℹ️ About — with the rest behind ℹ️.
👕 Each theme has a starter outfit (nature, mission or rainbow T-shirt) with its own held item and scene. Switching theme swaps the starter items; anything bought stays owned.

kids: 🏠 Your own room, your own character and a Shop that matches what you love — animals, space, music or football
items: 🧭 A new student space: on laptops a side rail with your character, name, points and streak, the five areas (Today, Practise, Mock exam, Learn, 🏠 My room), a pinned 🔊 sound button and 👪 Grown-ups; a slim header; the page uses the full width. On phones the bar stays at the bottom with sound pinned at the top right.
🏠 My room (was Rewards): your character, the 🛍️ Shop (renamed from Kit Shop), 🎨 My theme, medals, the leaderboard and — once found — your games.

🛍️ Each theme has its own Shop: animals (ranger shirts, wellies, binoculars, hedgehog, fox, owl, forest and ocean scenes), space (flight suits, helmets, robot buddy, moon base) and music & art (smocks, guitars, headphones, parrot, stage and gallery). Football themes keep the original Shop. Arcade game names follow the theme (e.g. Garden Guardians, Pony Derby).

👧 Adding a player asks what they love (theme), whether their character is a girl or a boy, and their team for football. New children start with their theme’s starter items and focus topics chosen from their exam.

👪 Grown-ups: the parent dashboard now has 👨‍👩‍👧 Family & data (save, open, export, every-question export, players and family codes), and the parent box has left the children’s screen. ⚙️ Menu is in the usual order: switch player, theme & character, sound, voices, help, install, grown-ups.
🐞 Fixed “undefined%” on the Keep training bars for new players.

kids: 🎨 Choose your own theme: Football (any team), Space, Animals or Music & art — even the questions change!
items: 🖥️ Wide screens use the space: Today shows the next best thing beside today’s plan; Practise and Mock exam have missions on the left, the question in the middle and the coach and game modes on the right; Rewards puts your player beside medals and the leaderboard. Phones still stack.
⚙️ The menu now drops down under its button instead of hiding behind the header.

🎨 Themes (⚙️ Menu → 🎨 Theme), chosen per child: ⚽ Anfield (the original), ⚽ Football — my team (any club name and team colour), 🚀 Space, 🐾 Animals & nature and 🎵 Music & art. Each changes the colours, background, header and sticker, and the stories in the questions — in practice and in Starlane — while the maths stays the same.

kids: 🧭 A tidier app: Today, Practise, Mock exam, Learn and Rewards along the top (or the bottom on a phone)
items: 🧭 New layout: the home page is organised into five areas — 🎯 Today (with one big “next best thing” button), ✏️ Practise, 🏆 Mock exam, 📚 Learn and 🎁 Rewards — shown one at a time, with the bar at the bottom on phones. Starting practice from anywhere jumps to Practise; “⛶ Focus on the question” hides everything else. The header buttons (switch player, help, sound, voices, install) are in ⚙️ Menu, and the save banner shrinks to a chip once progress is saved.

👪 Parent dashboard regrouped: Overview (summary cards), 📋 Plan (exam plan and key dates), 📈 Progress (readiness, focus areas, topics, question types, mocks, learning), ⏱️ Time & activity, 🎮 Games & rewards (Starlane, shop) and ⚙️ Settings & data — plus a “find anything” box.
📱 Fixed: on narrow phones the save banner no longer makes the page scroll sideways.

kids: ⬆️ Questions now get harder as you get them right — just like the real ISEB test
items: ⬆️ Difficulty levels for every exam: each question type is rated easy, medium or hard, and the numbers lean smaller at Warm-up and bigger at Stretch. Match-day practice and mocks are now adaptive — three right first time in a row steps up a level, two misses steps down — like the real adaptive ISEB Pre-Test. Warm-up and Boss stay as fixed levels. Starlane follows the child’s level too.

✏️ Twelve new stretch question types within the Year 5 curriculum for Tiffin, the 11+ grammars and the ISEB Pre-Test: square and cube numbers, primes, factors, L-shaped areas and perimeters, chained percentages, fractions of a remainder, Roman numerals, “who am I?” number clues, negative temperatures, overnight timetables and decimal calculations.
🧹 Questions that came out too easy by accident (equal ratio parts such as 5:5, fractions like 4/4, × 1 or + 0) are thrown away and made again.
⏱ Quick-fire exams show a pace guide (about a minute a question) and the current level on the question screen.

kids: 🎯 The top of the app now shows which school and test you are training for, with a countdown
items: 🎯 Exam plan: each child has a plan of tests (test, school, date, result). The app trains for the next upcoming one, and moves on when a test has passed. The header shows it — “Training for: Eton College — ISEB Common Pre-Test · 30 November 2026 · 17 days to go” — with a countdown sticker in the last 60 days. Tapping it opens the plan (grown-ups only).

📈 Readiness for the chosen exam, topic by topic (including maths answered in Starlane), with a printable report; 📅 key dates for the plan’s exams from the official timelines (Tiffin, ISEB, Eton, Common Entrance).
🏆 Mocks follow the exam: question count, timing and multiple choice where the real test uses it.
➕ Adding a player now asks what they are preparing for (or “not sure yet”) and their school.

✏️ New original questions for 13+ Common Entrance / scholarship (algebra, probability, polygons, circles, prisms, reverse percentages, the nth term, indices, compound interest) and quick-fire questions for Tiffin Stage 1, 11+ grammar and the ISEB Pre-Test. Each is only used for those exams, in practice and in Starlane.
